messages:
Nina (Design): quick run-through of the batch vectors preview + export flow. pasted updated frames in Figma: https://figma.com/file/unique
Sam (Frontend): thanks — can you call out the top three issues we need to fix before launch?
Nina (Design): must-fix: 1) selection appears per-page (users expect multi-page). 2) export modal closes but focus doesn't return to header CTA. 3) relevance score chip contrast is too low at small sizes.
Isla (A11y): for (1) announce selection count with an aria-live region and persist selection across pages. for (2) modal should trap focus, role="dialog", aria-modal="true" and return focus to the primary trigger.
Rohit (PM): product note: default export should be JSONL. surface CSV as a clear alternative that opens a column-mapping step. microcopy: "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)" and a second CTA: "Export CSV — map columns".
Diego (Backend): backend can accept explicit vector_id lists for exports. frontend can send ids array; we can support background jobs for >10k ids and email the user when ready.
Sam (Frontend): implementation plan: add persistent selection store (localStorage) and aria-live banner. also change truncated metadata to show an accessible tooltip on focus + a copy icon (aria-label="Copy full value").
Isla (A11y): also ensure sort buttons have aria-sort and announce changes via aria-live. action buttons need descriptive aria-labels ("Open actions for vector v123").
DeployBot: staging deploy completed with figma tweaks. :rocket:
Nina (Design): next steps: Sam to implement selection persistence + focus behavior; Diego to add background export endpoint; Isla to draft a small a11y checklist for the PR; Rohit to confirm CTA wording. target: PRs by Tuesday EOD. :thumbsup:
